docs.description: Complete design docs: epic, architecture, schema (54 tables), engines (13), seeds, API, implementation plan. Read in doc order 00-08, then SOTA-00 through SOTA-09.

research.description: Run deep research on a topic and wire findings into devops
research.template: Load the devops-research skill and research the following topic: $ARGUMENTS. Steps: 1. Classify (unit/ADR/general). 2. Execute multi-source research (firecrawl + exa or web-search-prime fallback). 3. Produce full report, brief, and evidence. 4. Wire into devops (INDEX, FRESHNESS, CROSS-REF). 5. If unit-linked: update tracker. If ADR-linked: attach brief. 6. Report: paths + confidence + source count.
